incidents.name: PandorasNodes404 transferFrom underflow
incidents.notes: The ERC-404 clone's transferFrom returned no boolean and underflowed its balance bookkeeping, letting the attacker mint balance out of the pair and sell it for the pool's WETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: PandorasNodes404 0xddaDF1bf44363D07E750C20219C2347Ed7D826b9 (a Pandora ERC-404 copycat, not the original Pandora token) created 2024-02-08T16:06:35Z by 0x1c19477876bffb8588decc11a9d478a255c0aee4, 11 minutes before the incident and unrelated to the attack sender 0x096f0f03...; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (660 seconds). Loss ~$17K per the PoC header, taken as WETH.
